_doc: MEDIA — YouTube channels for the Media tab. Each channel's per-channel Atom feed (`https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<ID>`) is fetched through the EXISTING rss/Atom path (RssParser.kt) — YouTube's Atom is just a different URL shape, not a second parser. All 8 channel_ids below were verified reachable (200, real entries) by hand just before this file was written. Two further ids found elsewhere in this repo — UCcflMGx-VSrcqQMGKmKzKHA and UCqWbKxpXU3wKlnpQnwvX8Kw — were probed at the same time and BOTH 404; they are deliberately excluded here rather than shipped as a channel that always renders empty/broken (same reasoning as data/sources.json's dw-en _doc_channels note on rss-en-sci). Modelled as channels of one synthetic `youtube-media` source (see MediaModels.kt's MediaConfig) so NewsSync's existing fixed-rss-source machinery (fetch only the ACTIVE channel per refresh, never all of them) is reused unchanged. Adding a channel is an entry HERE plus a rebuild — no Kotlin change. Baked into BuildConfig.MEDIA_B64 by app/build.gradle, same pattern as data/topics.json/data/sources.json.
_doc_fields: id: stable slug, used as the NewsStore cache key's channel half and as the persisted 'active channel' value. label: shown in the Media tab channel picker. channel_id: the raw YouTube channel id (UC...) the feed URL is built from.
